messages:
Mia (Marketing): Hey design — need a quick help sprint for launch visuals tied to next Tue webinar + benchmark assets. Two priority deliverables: 1) "Lightning benchmark" one-pager (A4 / letter) with cost vs latency sparkline, small model comparison grid, 3 callout blurbs. 2) Social & web hero pack: 1200x630, 800x800, 1080x1920 + a thumbnail variant. Figma file here: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-kit (open to anyone on the team). Brand constraints: use updated type scale + primary palette only. Deadline: draft comps by Thu EOD so we can review Fri. Ping @Leo for capacity. Full ask + data pasted below. Thanks! :rocket:

BrandBot: Brand checklist (auto):
• Use Primary Palette v2 (do not use AccentNeon)
• Logo lockups: single-line for social; stacked for one-pager
• Accessible contrast: AA minimum for body text
• Preferred fonts: Redwood Sans / Redwood Mono fallback
• Export formats: PNG web, PDF print, SVG icons
(See https://brand.redwood.example/kit)

Leo (Design): Got it. Thanks Mia. A couple quick clarifications: do we want the one-pager to be more data-forward (lots of small charts) or more narrative (big hero stat + 3 highlights)? Also can we get sample numbers for the sparkline & grid?

Mia (Marketing): Prefer data-forward but compact — think 3 micro charts + comparison grid. Hero stat can be p99 latency for our recommended config. I'll paste CSV snippet in a sec.

Cam (Engineering): Copy of the data export — small sample below (full sheet in Figma notes):
```
model,profile,p99_latency_ms,throughput_tok_per_s,cost_per_1k_tokens_usd
redwood-7b,fp16,78,220,0.012
redwood-14b,qt8,110,140,0.018
open-7b,fp16,130,100,0.010
```
Use p99 for latency stat and cost_per_1k for the cost sparkline.

Leo (Design): Perfect, thanks. For the comparison grid: do we need vendor logos or just model names? Also do we have high-res model icons?

Mia (Marketing): No vendor logos — just model names and small badge for "Redwood verified" where applicable. We'll need alt text for each image. Also include a tiny explainer line for how the cost calc works.

Sara (PM): Messaging alignment — suggested headline: "Ship inference that scales — predictable latency, lower unit cost." Subhead: "Redwood Inference: production-first serving for real workloads." CTA for the one-pager: "Download benchmark kit" (link will be gated). Please include a short blurb (20–25 words) describing methodology.

Leo (Design): Re: icons — BrandBot, can we pull the verified badge and the new data glyph from the icon library?

BrandBot: Links: Verified badge SVG — https://assets.brand/verified.svg ; Data glyph set — https://assets.brand/dataglyphs.zip. Use the 24px outline glyph for charts.

Leo (Design): Cool. I'll mock two layouts for the one-pager (grid-heavy and narrative-heavy) and drop frames in Figma. Plan: start with 300dpi PDF export for print + optimized PNGs for web. Thumbnails as 200px wide. ETA: Thu 6pm PT for first drafts.

Mia (Marketing): Amazing — thanks Leo. For social pack, tone: punchy stat + minimal copy. I'll add 3 caption variants in the Figma notes.

Cam (Engineering): Quick ask for design — when you place sparklines, keep the x-axis normalized to tokens processed (not time). If you want sample JSON for chart rendering, I can paste it.

Leo (Design): Please paste JSON sample, Cam. I can plug into chart component.

Cam (Engineering): JSON sample (tiny):
```json
{"series":[{"name":"cost","points":[0.012,0.013,0.015,0.018],"labels":["1k","2k","5k","10k"]}]}
```
Use monotone palette (primary->secondary) for lines.

Sara (PM): Also need the accessibility checklist for the one-pager before finalizing. BrandBot — any auto-checker?

BrandBot: Accessibility quick checks: color contrast OK for text >=14px. Include alt text for all images. Export PDFs with tagged text. Use semantic headings.

Leo (Design): Noted. One more: do we want animated hero (GIF) for social? Low priority but can do if marketing wants motion.

Mia (Marketing): Low priority — keep it static this round. If we have time on Fri, we can iterate on a 4-frame GIF for twitter/X.

Sara (PM): I'll own the copy edits. Once designs land Thu, I'll prepare final microcopy + link to gated download.

Mia (Marketing): Great — assigning to @Leo. @Cam can you confirm the full data CSV is in Figma notes by EOD?

Cam (Engineering): Confirmed — uploaded full CSV + raw run logs to Figma notes. :white_check_mark:

Leo (Design): Starting comps now. I’ll post frames and export specs in thread when ready. :sparkles:

Mia (Marketing): Thank you team — will review Thu and flag changes. :rocket:
